## Constraints

### Must

- Keep all public claims grounded in available product behavior and measured demo data.
- Preserve the existing authenticated product, analytics pipeline, and application routes.
- Use a near-black editorial system with acid green as the sole primary accent.

### Avoid

- Do not use Signal Score, archetypes, confidence claims, projections, mastery claims, or decorative Digital DNA.
- Do not imply that planned integrations or Signal Capture are currently available.
- Do not use generic dashboard-template compositions or gratuitous glass cards.

## Decisions

- The public narrative moves from scattered source activity to traceable history, measured patterns, and recurring topics.
- Scroll motion reinforces aggregation and continuity while reduced-motion users receive an equivalent static experience.
- Future connected-source examples are explicitly labeled as concepts with illustrative data.
